children: Following completion of its merger, the company notified Nasdaq that each share was converted into the right to receive merger consideration and requested a trading halt, withdrawal from Nasdaq, and filing of Form 25 to delist and deregister. The company also intends to file Form 15 to terminate registration and suspend reporting obligations.
